why: The HTMT is a general psychometric discriminant-validity statistic for structural-equation measurement models, not a general theory of learning or teaching and not specifically an education research method.
The HTKS is a named, administered assessment instrument for measuring behavioral self-regulation rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: Head-Toes-Knees-Shoulders (HTKS) task
product_description: A brief, game-like direct assessment developed for young children that measures behavioral self-regulation through rule reversal, attention, working-memory, and inhibitory-control tasks.

why: HTA combined with SHERPA is a structured human-factors method for analyzing procedural steps and identifying training-relevant errors, not a general theory of learning.
name: Human reliability analysis via hierarchical task analysis (HTA) and SHERPA
